info.prompt: A cyber-gothic battlefield where skeletal gold filigree arches frame hexagonal combat tiles, each pulsing with neon cyan/magenta energy as the closing circle contracts. The outer tiles char to blackened ruin every 30 seconds, edges crumbling first into the void black abyss while electric amber warnings flash across neural lattice pathways. At the center, a rogue-class player's dice glow with stolen cathedral light, their HUD a cascade of terminal code and radial health bars that fracture like stained glass under Farkle reversal explosions.
